name: backlight
blurb: Wraps children with blur and color saturation filter.
description: Applies an SVG filter that blurs and increases saturation of child elements, creating a glow/backlight effect.
use_when: Visual emphasis on text or elements, glowing badge effects, or artistic styling.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical text (blur harms readability); motion-sensitive users.
a11y: Filter wrapper only. Does not affect semantic content or focus.
